title: transformer-maintenance: Simulation code and data for a physics-informed digital twin of substation transformers
description:
Simulation framework, generated datasets, trained model weights, result files and figure scripts supporting the IEEE Access manuscript Access-2026-53764, Physics-Informed Digital Twin With Distilled Edge Inference for Predictive Maintenance of Substation Transformers: A Model-Based Validation (first revision, R1).

Contents: IEC 60076-7 thermal simulation of a three-phase 20 MVA ONAF transformer; physics-informed neural network (PINN) hot-spot estimation benchmarked against an IEC difference-equation model, a Kalman/RTS smoother, a joint-parameter extended Kalman filter and an identified gray-box model under five structurally different ground-truth generators; local identifiability analysis; knowledge-distilled INT8 edge classifier with 2 x 5 repeated cross-validation, paired tests, cross-condition and cross-severity tests; remaining-useful-life estimators with sensitivity analysis; reconstruction-based integrity validation. All results are simulation results. Master seed 20260905; README.md maps every table and figure to its script.
